phoneticFeatureBinding: An exclusive binding artifact must be created from completed, fully verified extraction outputs before launching any fit. Its SHA and source pins are retained in every run; no placeholder feature hash is accepted.
architecture: MeanPoolPhoneRatingHead with one 1024-value phonetic vector per target row; optional13CTC scalars give1037inputs. Shared128wide acoustic projection,128phone embedding and three-class MLP.
normalization: Population column mean/SD from exactly the regime/fold inner-fit target rows; SD below1e-6 becomes1; fixed for validation and replay
objective: Mean five-rater unweighted soft-label NLL; no class weighting or probability correction
selection: Within family/regime/fold choose epoch by all-age inner macro-phone NLL for all-age fit, or ages6–12 inner macro-phone NLL for child-only fit. Improvements must exceed1e-7; retain earlier epoch otherwise. Across the two LRs select lower loss, exact ties prefer0.0003.
priorComparator: Per-phone +1/class prior fitted on exactly this regime/fold fit rows; missing fit support explicitly reported, with uniform prior for absent targets
featureIntegrity: Original row order and identity, completed feature/config/index, extraction recipe/checkpoint/source pins, both1024wide finite float32 matrices, every per-clip unit and exact repeated global vectors must validate
reporting: Retain every trial, best/last checkpoint, history, saved probabilities, per-age proper/ranking/support metrics, same-fit priors, exactCPU replay and provenance
outerEvaluation: No outer-refit or outer-prediction entrypoint; saved inner discovery results only
limitations: Fixed target windows remain forced canonical CTC hypotheses; contextual vectors contain surrounding utterance information.
The five-rater target is a subjective corpus rating distribution, not a produced-phone or child speech-sound-disorder correctness label.
Both age regimes select on their declared inner outcomes; no resulting interval or comparison is independent of that selection.
